speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are? Also, can you describe the severity of the abdominal pain and the amount of vaginal bleeding you are experiencing?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of placenta previa, and have you noticed any trauma to your abdomen recently? I need to know if the pain is constant or if it comes in waves to help differentiate the cause.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Vaginal bleeding. I also have Severe abdominal pain, History of contractions that stopped, Previous cesarean delivery.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the severe pain, vaginal bleeding, and history of prior cesarean section at term, I am highly concerned for uterine rupture. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound.
